Alicia —

Thanks, and absolutely — attached is a consolidated response and a short on-call template for your SOW. Key points at a glance: 

- TAM coverage: 24x7 global coverage via our Dedicated TAMs and regional CS leads. Primary contact for TriCounty would be Marissa Cole (US business hours coverage), with Ben Carter designated as secondary (EMEA/APAC overlap). We provide named TAMs for Dedicated customers and a guaranteed response SLA for Sev-1 incidents of 15 minutes for phone escalation, 60 minutes for a technical remediation plan.

- Escalation ladder (summary): Tier 1 (TAM) -> Tier 2 (Platform Reliability Engineer) -> Tier 3 (On-call Runtime Eng) -> Incident Commander (exec on-call if >8 hours active). We include automatic cross-notification to your security & procurement contacts for Sev-1.

- Notification windows: Acknowledgement within 15 minutes (Sev-1), initial triage update within 60 minutes, hourly updates until containment, and a post-incident report within 5 business days.

- On-call template: attached as "Oncall-Rotation-Template.xlsx" — includes suggested 8-hour shifts, 2-week primary rotations, and escalation matrix fields to populate.

- Audit evidence: Redwood is SOC 2 Type II compliant; we can provide redacted auditor attestations and a SOC 2 bridge letter under NDA.

I've put the detailed SOW-style language in the attached "Redwood_TAM_Coverage_SOW.pdf" for insertion into your vendor packet. If you prefer, Marissa (cc'd) can run a 30-minute walkthrough with your procurement and ops teams to walk through the flows.

Attachments:
- Redwood_TAM_Coverage_SOW.pdf (PDF, 6 pages)
- Oncall-Rotation-Template.xlsx (Excel)

Best,
Naomi Feldman
